issue.title: Retire slim_agents_manifest
issue.description: Owner-manifest writes (fresh publish, digest repair, and manifest repair) omit each hood's per-hood files list, and reads use the dedicated larger manifest byte and hood-count caps with lenient old-reader skip for the omitted-files shape

task_type_fields.remove_when: every owner manifest in every agents sidecar has been rewritten without per-hood files and every owner machine (athena, apollo, kellys_mbp) runs a sase whose reader tolerates slim manifests
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Owner-manifest writes emit the full per-hood files list byte-for-byte as before (the legacy fat writer), and the equality cross-check against the hood snapshot's derived file set runs unconditionally
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Owner-manifest writes (fresh publish, digest repair, and manifest repair) omit each hood's per-hood files list, and reads use the dedicated larger manifest byte and hood-count caps with lenient old-reader skip for the omitted-files shape

payload.entry: Retired per approved epic sase-1jc (plan 202610/retire_all_feature_flags, user-authorized clean slate; supersedes dossier wait dates). slim_agents_manifest enum member + registry definition removed; publication_planning + publication_repair (digest + manifest) writers now always omit per-hood files; schema regenerated; focused suites green (agents_sync manifest/repair 78 passed). Reads still accept old explicit lists.
